## [1.1.0](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-09-28)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **feature-buttons:** kill AI MIX playlist button via its own gate flag ([3904488](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/39044889e69039b646e2e676faa5cdcea39c1fba))
* **upsell:** remove Library promo at source to close bind-gap ([54f1fdf](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/54f1fdfcb951a7f126517fd387a73bb8d168b5b0))

### ✨ New Features

* hide AI MIX, karaoke-upsell and shuffle-badge buttons in Remove ads ([3307905](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/330790575c0f0e67095cf1c8f5100fddd877d858))

patches.name: Disable audio ads
patches.description: Forces AdSettings.noAd=true and PlayQueue.getDisableAds=true so songs are treated as ad-free locally. Client flag only.

patches.name: Hide Gold features
patches.description: Forces Account.isGold/isGoldUser and all GoldUtilsKt.isGold overloads to false. Hides server-gated Gold UI instead of spoofing it.

patches.name: Hide shuffle badges
patches.description: Hides PLAYS IN SHUFFLE badges on playlist/album headers, feed cards, and rows. Cosmetic only.

patches.name: Hide upgrade upsell
patches.description: Hides the nav upgrade entry, header promo banner, feed upsell cards and AI MIX button model (gap-free), and settings subscribe banner. Server-driven UI the Plus spoof cannot remove.

patches.name: Hide upsell feature buttons
patches.description: Hides TRY SING ALONG karaoke upsell, the player AI MIX switch, and the playlist AI MIX button. Feature gates untouched.

patches.name: Remove popup promos
patches.description: No-ops the in-house popup funnel, the fullscreen startup dialog, and the flyer ad callback. Google SDK ads untouched.

patches.name: Spoof stock app signature
patches.description: Forces SignatureUtils.getAppSignature to hash with the stock cert prefix (he9B...kw=), so X-ANGH-APP-RGSIG matches a stock install. Salt/body hashing unchanged.

patches.name: Unforce shuffle
patches.description: No-ops PlayQueue.shuffle(), forces server shuffleOn=false at both sync points, disables the pick-a-song radio redirect, enables shuffle buttons, and disarms the shuffle upsell dialog. Manual shuffle toggle keeps working.

patches.name: Unlock downloads
patches.description: No-ops download limit asserts, forces limited-plan=false and large offline caps (999999). Local gates only; the server still authorizes files.

patches.name: Unlock local Plus
patches.description: Forces Account.isPlus/isPlusUser=true, enablePlayerRestrictions=false, canPlayOfflineAndFree=true. Local UI/gating only; server premium checks remain.

patches.name: Unlock playback limits
patches.description: Disables skip and queue limits (skipLimitReached/queueRestrictionsEnabled=false, disable-flags=true). Local gates only.
